verdict.rationale: The UCP protocol site lists named co-developers beyond Shopify (Google, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart, etc.), describes UCP as industry-built, and publishes an open versioned spec with reference implementations on GitHub. Shopify also claims a Universal Cart spanning merchants 'on or off Shopify'. However, the co-developer list is a vendor-side claim, the Universal Cart is waitlisted, and every runtime probe hit only Shopify-operated endpoints. missing for 10: concrete evidence of at least two independent parties shipping live UCP implementations, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-Shopify endpoints or agents.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration

citations.quote: UCP is built by the industry, to enable seamless agentic experiences
Google Shopify Etsy Wayfair Target Walmart Amazon Microsoft Meta Salesforce Stripe
an open standard that enables gen AI agents to safely, securely, and privately execute commerce actions
The Universal Cart API lets AI agents collect items from any merchant, on or off Shopify, into a single, unified cart, all via UCP.
